question: I have a diagnosis and my doctor says I should apply for the disability tax credit. Can you confirm that CRA will approve me?
generated_answer: CRA cannot confirm whether you will be approved for the disability tax credit. The disability tax credit is a benefit that is administered by the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) and is intended to provide tax relief to individuals who have a severe and prolonged impairment in physical or mental functions. The CRA reviews each application on a case-by-case basis and makes a determination based on the information provided. If you have a diagnosis and your doctor has recommended that you apply for the disability tax credit, you should submit an application to the CRA. The CRA will review your application and make a determination based on the information provided. If you are approved, you will be eligible to claim the disability tax credit on your income tax return.
